NIVA-AS-9.5-COPAY.title: 5% co-payment on admissible amount
NIVA-AS-9.5-COPAY.quote: Each and every claim under the Policy shall be subject to a Copayment of 5% applicable to claim amount admissible and payable as per the terms and conditions of the Policy.
NIVA-AS-9.5-COPAY.source: Arogya Sanjeevani Policy, Niva Bupa Health Insurance Co. Ltd.

NIVA-AS-9.6-SETTLEMENT.title: Settle or reject within 15 days, else penal interest
NIVA-AS-9.6-SETTLEMENT.quote: The Company shall settle or reject a claim, as the case may be, within 15 days from the claim submission date. ii. ln the case of delay in the payment of a claim, the Company shall be liable to pay interest from the date of receipt of claim intimation till the date of payment of claim at a rate of 2% above the bank rate.
NIVA-AS-9.6-SETTLEMENT.source: Arogya Sanjeevani Policy, Niva Bupa Health Insurance Co. Ltd.

NP-AS-LII-027.title: Items that are to be subsumed into Room Charges: ADMISSION KIT
NP-AS-LII-027.quote: The policy wording says this is subsumed into room charges, so it is not paid as a separate line and a separate-line deduction is fair. At a network hospital you can ask the hospital to absorb it, but the 2020 IRDAI instruction that insurers stop hospitals billing these items was superseded in May 2024, so this is a request, not an enforceable right. Challenge only if the room charge itself was cut because of it.

NP-AS-LIV-001.title: Items that are to be subsumed into costs of treatment: ADMISSION/REGISTRATION CHARGES
NP-AS-LIV-001.quote: The policy wording says this is subsumed into cost of treatment (incl. diagnostics), so a separate-line deduction is fair. At a network hospital you can ask the hospital to absorb it (a request, not an enforceable right since the 2020 circular was superseded).

grievance.body:
Date: 17 September 2026

To
The Grievance Redressal Officer
Nirmaan Health Insurance Co. Ltd.

Subject: Grievance against deductions in claim no. CLM-NHI-26-0902214, policy no. NHI/AS/2026/0310552

Dear Sir/Madam,

I am writing about the above claim for the hospitalisation of Farhan Qureshi at Greenfield Hospital from 25 August 2026 to 29 August 2026 (Dengue fever with thrombocytopenia). Your office settled the claim by letter dated 12 September 2026, paying ₹33,687 against ₹39,760 claimed.

I have checked the decision against the policy wording (Arogya Sanjeevani Policy, Niva Bupa Health Insurance Co. Ltd. (UIN NBHHLIP27056V042627)) and IRDAI's regulations, and I dispute the following:

None.

I request you to pay the wrongly deducted ₹0 (about ₹0 after co-payment), and to reply with reasons that refer to the specific terms of the policy. I understand IRDAI requires grievances to be acknowledged immediately and resolved within 14 days. If the grievance is not resolved, I will approach the Insurance Ombudsman under the Insurance Ombudsman Rules, 2017.

Enclosures: policy schedule, hospital bill, discharge summary, your settlement letter dated 12 September 2026.

Yours faithfully,
Farhan Qureshi
Policy no. NHI/AS/2026/0310552
